entry.summary: Releases a dataset of image, local sketch, instruction, and edited-image quadruplets synthesized through a multimodal-language-model pipeline, then trains a model for sketch-plus-instruction local editing with pixel-level precision. It targets fine-grained geometric deformations that text alone cannot specify.

entry.title: RAGMesh with FaME-G2E: Long-Form Text-Driven 3D Face Generation and Editing

author.name: Hao Li, Ju Dai, Feng Zhou, Mengting Shi, Haofei Wang, Zhen Song, Wei Zhou, Lei Li, Junjun Pan

entry.summary: Contributes a large multimodal dataset pairing detailed text with 3D face meshes and blendshapes, and a retrieval-augmented framework that turns long-form descriptions into fine-grained facial geometry and edits. It focuses on subtle local deformations such as eyebrow tension and asymmetric mouth motion that global alignment misses.

entry.title: Warp-free Cross-view Geo-localization via Feature-space Consensus Mining

author.name: Zhuo Song, Lian Xu, Runqing Jiang, Yongjian Zhang, Kunhong Li, Ye Zhang, Yulan Guo

entry.summary: Removes explicit geometric warping from cross-view street-to-satellite geo-localization, arguing that warping relies on restrictive spatial assumptions and injects severe distortion. Instead the method mines and strengthens semantic consensus directly in feature space through an auxiliary joint-view branch.

entry.title: Revisiting the Current Frame: Physical-Trace-Guided Network Output Correction for Video Restoration

author.name: Yifeng Lin, Liuxiang Qiu, Guangming Ren, Tiesong Zhao

entry.summary: ANCHOR is a model-agnostic post-processing framework for video restoration that treats the degraded current frame as a temporally aligned reference and estimates a per-pixel trust field to decide where network outputs should be corrected. It targets a mostly unexamined issue: spatially varying reliability of restored outputs when reference frames introduce occlusion or aggregation errors.

entry.title: Preserve More Details: Mitigating Content Drift in Real-World Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Chunxiao Liu, Wei Liu, Anbin Xiong, Erli Meng

entry.summary: FSP-Diff is a one-step diffusion model for real-world image super-resolution with a dual-pathway design that separates detail conditioning from semantic guidance to reduce content drift, where generated details or text semantics deviate from the low-quality input. The focus is preserving fidelity while keeping single-step efficiency.

entry.title: Identifying potentiating events in evolutionary search using replay experiments

author.name: Austin J. Ferguson, Alexander Lalejini

entry.summary: This paper imports replay experiments from experimental evolutionary biology into evolutionary computation, restarting runs from different historical checkpoints to identify potentiating events that made a later outcome likely. It provides a step-by-step design guide plus demonstrations of the analysis.

entry.title: TAMS: Task-Aware Multi-View Adaptive Streaming for Wireless Telerobotic Manipulation

author.name: Zexin Deng, Zhenhui Yuan, Lu Tian, Subhash Lakshminarayana, Longhao Zou

entry.summary: TAMS allocates limited uplink bitrate across multiple teleoperation camera views according to the inferred manipulation phase, prioritizing the currently relevant view while keeping baseline visibility elsewhere. On a six-DOF teleoperation testbed under constrained networks it improved primary-view image quality, task time, and success rate over equal and static allocation.

entry.title: Exact Contraction Rates via the Berkson--Porta Representation: A Sharp Threshold and Its Herglotz-Kernel Obstruction

author.name: Soumic Sarkar

entry.summary: Uses the Berkson-Porta representation of holomorphic semigroups on the unit disc to determine exactly when a flow contracts the Kobayashi metric at the optimal linearization rate rather than a conservative one, reducing the question to a single pointwise inequality. The inequality is fully resolved for a natural one-parameter family and an obstruction is identified via Herglotz kernels.

entry.title: Parameter-Dependent LMI Synthesis for Semi-Global Differential ISS Trajectory Tracking of Nonholonomic Mobile Robots Under Multiplicative Wheel Slip

author.name: Mohammad Sabouri

entry.summary: Develops a parameter-dependent LMI synthesis for trajectory tracking of nonholonomic mobile robots under severe multiplicative wheel slip, certifying semi-global differential input-to-state stability, prescribed decay rate, pole placement, and bounded gains simultaneously. A key contribution is an explicit bound translating multiplicative slip into an additive disturbance in Kanayama error coordinates.

entry.title: Trajectory-Induced Self-Calibration for Hidden-Target Localization Through an Unknown-Pose Range-Bearing Relay

author.name: Yash Bagla

entry.summary: Characterizes the minimal vehicle motion needed to localize a hidden target when the only information comes from a relay beacon of unknown position and yaw reporting local-frame range and bearing to both vehicle and target. One pose leaves a continuous gauge ambiguity while two distinct relative observations resolve it.

entry.title: Conditionally Resampled Sliding-Window Count Kernels: Spectral-Gap Bounds and Poincar\'e Inequalities

author.name: Yanjin Xiang, Yuchen Xin, Zhihua Zhang

entry.summary: Establishes a Poincare inequality and an explicit spectral-gap lower bound scaling inversely with window length for the conditionally resampled sliding-window count kernel derived from a reversible finite-state Markov chain. The proof combines a martingale oscillation inequality for the path law with a direct argument.

entry.title: Is it ethical to work on general-purpose robots given the risk of totalitarianism?

author.name: Master Chief

entry.summary: A question post asking whether it is ethical to work on general-purpose robots that can learn physical tasks and manufacture copies of themselves, given that such capabilities could drastically lower the cost of enforcing a totalitarian regime. The author notes a gap in existing literature, which covers autonomous weapons but not general robotics as a coercion-enablement pathway.

entry.title: Evidence-Calibrated Runtime Reconstruction for Agent Skills Across Heterogeneous Coding Agents

author.name: Xueping Gao

entry.summary: Describes a passive runtime observability system that reconstructs the lifecycle stages of reusable agent skill packages across heterogeneous coding agent harnesses, explicitly marking unsupported stages as unknown. Separates immutable events, deterministic relations, inferred diagnoses, and verified outcomes with graded evidence levels, and supports standard trace import and export.

entry.title: Universal or Language-Family-Specific Script Unification for Cross-Lingual Transfer? A Case Study on Turkic Languages

author.name: Zijie Zhang

entry.summary: Compares a general-purpose romanizer against a language-family-specific common script for unifying writing systems across eleven Turkic languages, training matched embedding models and evaluating on named entity recognition and part-of-speech tagging. Finds no significant difference on NER with both beating monolingual baselines, and no universal winner for tagging, with outcomes tracking cross-lingual character n-gram coverage.

entry.title: A Review of Vision-Based Vehicle Detection for UAV-Based Traffic Monitoring: Experimental Insights and Future Directions

author.name: Jianlin Ye, Christos Kyrkou

entry.summary: A survey of vision-based vehicle detection for UAV traffic monitoring that reviews recent deep learning approaches and adds experimental comparisons on accuracy and latency. It highlights deployment issues such as altitude variation, motion-induced distortion, and high-resolution processing cost.

entry.title: IRPol-Fuse: Energy-structure coordination for infrared polarization fusion under low visibility

author.name: Zhuangfan Huang, Chusheng Fang, Xiaosong Li, Yang Liua, Xiaoqi Cheng, Haishu Tan

entry.summary: IRPol-Fuse fuses infrared and polarization imagery for low-visibility perception, using attention-based allocation plus separate injectors that preserve infrared highlights and weak polarization textures. It targets the tendency of prior fusion methods to suppress faint but informative polarization detail in dark regions.

entry.title: CUPA-T2*: Covariance-Aware Uncertainty Propagation and Alignment for T2* Mapping in Accelerated MRI

author.name: Gideon N. L. Rouwendaal, Natascha Niessen, Hannah Eichhorn, Dirk H. J. Poot, Christine Preibisch, Julia A. Schnabel

entry.summary: Propagates voxel-wise uncertainty from Monte-Carlo-dropout accelerated MRI reconstructions into downstream quantitative T2-star parameter fitting using covariance-aware sampling and a heteroscedastic network with a variance-alignment regularizer. The goal is trustworthy quantitative biomarkers from undersampled scans.

entry.title: MPPI Planning with Gaussian Based Human Cost Function for Social Navigation

author.name: Chinmay Mundane

entry.summary: Adds predictive Gaussian interaction fields to MPPI social navigation, propagating pedestrian predictions across the planning horizon as anisotropic repulsive fields whose forward spread grows with walking speed. This replaces the common practice of treating people as static point obstacles at their current positions.

entry.title: Anchor-Based AI Approach for Pre-Crash Object Detection Utilizing Micro-Doppler Signatures in Automotive Radar

author.name: Patrick Zaumseil, Rainer Engert, Dagmar Steinhauser, Jonathan Wache, Soumya Dewangan, Thomas Brandmeier

entry.summary: Applies an anchor-based detector to automotive radar micro-Doppler signatures for pre-crash object detection and kinematic parameter estimation, aimed at reliably triggering irreversible restraint systems such as smart airbags. High-resolution radar features are shown to sharpen classification and state estimates in the moments before impact.

entry.title: Task-Oriented Formation Decision via Reinforcement Learning: Herding an Attacking Swarm

author.name: Zhaozong Wang, Guibin Sun, Jinyong Chen, Rui Zhou

entry.summary: Formulates multi-robot herding of a faster attacking swarm as a reinforcement learning problem over a low-dimensional parametric encoding of formation shape, so defenders optimize continuous formation parameters rather than selecting from predefined shapes. This addresses attackers with superior maneuverability and unknown strategies.

entry.title: Janus: An Algorithm-Evaluator Co-Evolution Framework for LLM-Driven Discovery under Expensive Evaluation Budgets

author.name: Ximeng Liu, Qianlong Wang, Yingming Mao, Annan Li, Yatao Li, Shizhen Zhao, Jianmin Wu, Dawei Yin, Dou Shen

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.08189v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM-driven program discovery relies on rapid evaluator feedback, but many scientific and engineering tasks require high-fidelity simulations, hardware ...

entry.title: Estimating Uncertainty in Galaxy Morphology Classification

author.name: Kai Cheng, Ruoqi Wang, Qiong Luo

entry.summary: The paper adds post-hoc uncertainty estimation to deep foundation models used for galaxy morphology classification, separating sources of uncertainty arising from noisy instruments and genuinely ambiguous evolving morphologies. Current astronomical classifiers are deterministic point estimators, so calibrated uncertainty improves scientific usability. It is a domain application of established uncertainty quantification ideas.

entry.title: Automated Generation of Complexity-Validated Decision Scenarios Using Large Language Models

author.name: Abdalla Doleh, Toni Somers, Ratna Babu Chinnam

entry.summary: The authors automate generation of decision-making scenarios with controlled cognitive complexity, validating over 4,000 generated scenarios against task-complexity theory with psychometric criteria and near-perfect agreement across five model families. This replaces slow, inconsistent manual scenario writing for behavioral research. It is an example of LLMs as instrument-construction tools for social science.

entry.title: Findings of the First Teaching Monster Challenge: A Benchmark of Pedagogical Content Knowledge in AI Agents

author.name: Yi-Cheng Lin, Yu-Kai Guo, Szu-Chi Chen, Bo-Han Feng, Yun-Man Hsu, Hsiang Hsieh, Yu-Jung Lin, Yue-Ling Wu, Jia-Kai Dong, An-Yu Cheng, Yu-Han Huang, Lok-Lam Ieong, Kuan-Yu Chen, Ming-Douo Tchouang, Shao-Hua Sun, Che Lin, Jian-Jiun Ding, Hung-yi Lee

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.08852v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI agents can now solve problems, answer like subject experts, and generate long-form multimodal content. However, whether they can adapt a lesson to f...

entry.title: Depth-Aware Implicit Neural Representation Priors for 3D Gravity Inversion

author.name: Le\'on Suarez-Rodriguez, Paul Goyes-Pe\~nafiel, Javier Torres-Quintero, Henry Arguello

entry.summary: An unsupervised approach to three-dimensional gravity inversion that represents the subsurface density field with multiple coordinate-based neural networks assigned to overlapping depth slabs, providing a depth-aware implicit prior without paired training data. This addresses the ill-posedness and depth attenuation that plague classical regularized inversion. A clean application of implicit neural representations to geophysical imaging.

entry.title: Different Feedback, Different Updates: Selective Self-Learning from User Interactions for Large Language Models

author.name: Xuanchen Li, Haitao Li, Yujia Zhou, Qingyi Pan, Heng Wang, Yiqun Liu, Min Zhang, Qingyao Ai

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.09109v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: User feedback offers natural supervision for persistent LLM improvement, but a single message may support multiple behavioral changes with different sc...

entry.title: MELLON - Multimodal Enhanced LLM for Online Navigation

author.name: Ruiyu Li, Haoyang Cai, Zhitong Guo, Tong Hu

entry.summary: MELLON adds multimodal enhancements to web navigation agents on the WebShop benchmark, including a visual question answering helper agent and a multimodal reranker, reporting a roughly nine point accuracy gain after one epoch of training. Explores text-image alignment for shopping-style web tasks.

entry.title: Bidirectional Context Self-Distillation for Reinforcement Learning of Skill-Based LLM Agents

author.name: Tianjun Pan, Yuan Li, Hongda Wang, Linbo Jin, Mengfei Song, Lei Gao, Qiming Shi, Shaokang Fu, Jiarong Zhao, Chengyu Wang, Chengfu Huo

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.09555v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: External natural-language skills provide large language model (LLM) agents with reusable and editable guidance for solving complex tasks. Yet their eff...

entry.title: CEAA: A Cognitive Embodied Agents Architecture for Interactive Computing Systems

author.name: Aimilios Hadjiliasi, Louis Nisiotis

entry.summary: Proposes CEAA, a modular cognitive architecture for embodied intelligent virtual agents in real-time interactive environments, combining the sense-think-act paradigm with belief-desire-intention style reasoning to bridge low-level engine-bound control and high-level reasoning models. Targets deployability in commercial game engines.

entry.title: How to Ask the AI: A User Perspective Survey for Large Language Model Prompting

author.name: Yiqun Zhang, Yunfan Zhang, Mingjie Zhao, Sen Feng, Yiu-ming Cheung

entry.summary: A survey of prompting from the end-user perspective, organizing principles and taxonomies for how non-expert users can structure effective requests to LLMs. Positions prompt construction as a systematic skill rather than casual typing.

entry.title: DA-NBV: A Direction-Aware Next-Best-View Planner for Efficient 3D Reconstruction of Ships at Sea

author.name: Jiaming Chen, Juntao Yang, Zhentao Zou, Qi Ming, Yi Yu, Zhihang Zhong, Xue Yang, Xue Jiang, Yue Zhou

entry.summary: Presents a direction-aware next-best-view planner that adds directional observation history to occupancy modelling so a robot or drone can efficiently reconstruct ships at sea despite heavy self-occlusion. Targets maritime supervision and damage assessment where manual capture trajectories are costly.

entry.title: CDGC-Net: 3D Medical Image Segmentation with Cooperative Dual-Scale Self-Attention and Grouped Channel Modeling

author.name: Zheyang Jing, Qin Lu, Jianwang Li, Yujie Yang, Chen Yi, Shaofeng Jiang

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.08575v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Accurate 3D medical image segmentation requires the integration of long-range anatomical context with fine boundary detail. Existing methods often mo...

entry.title: How Can Rhetoric Reward-Hack AI Reviewers? Dissecting Rhetorical Sensitivity in AI-Based Peer Review

author.name: Ming Li, Chenguang Wang, Xirui Li, Xinyue Zeng, Dianqi Li, Peng Shi, Dawei Zhou, Tianyi Zhou

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.08975v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As large language models increasingly participate in scientific evaluation, we investigate a potential form of reward hacking: how rhetorical choices...

entry.title: Guardian Crawler: Retrieval-First Knowledge Discovery with Bounded LLM Augmentation for Noisy Web Intelligence

author.name: Joshua Castillo, Santosh Nukavarapu, Ravi Mukkamala

entry.summary: Examines whether transparent prescription contact lenses degrade iris recognition and proposes a two-stage mask-guided attention detector for them. Shows with a commercial matcher that clear lenses do measurably raise verification error, contradicting the common assumption of no effect.

entry.title: A Unified Issue Resolution Benchmark for Requirement Clarification, Planning, and Code Generation for Coding Agents

author.name: Xin Zhou, Chun Yong Chong, Kisub Kim, Yun Peng, Rui Shu, Zihan Wu, Xu Han, Guowen Yuan, Zeyang Zhuang, Jounghoon Kim, Jeongjin Ju, Seongmin Ju, Taein Yoon, David Lo

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.09072v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language model-powered coding agents are increasingly used to modify existing code repositories, for example, by adding features or fixing bugs...

entry.title: FedA2L: Adaptive layer-wise learning rate adjustment in decentralized federated learning

author.name: Van Truong Vo, Khoa Nguyen, Taehong Kim

entry.summary: FedA2L adapts per-layer learning rates in decentralized federated learning using model divergence signals, on the premise that early layers must maintain consensus while later layers specialize to local data. Aims to fix slow convergence under non-IID client distributions.

entry.title: Deep Learning based Detection of Fishing Vessels and Fishing Monitoring using Nightlight Images

author.name: Shantakar Mohanty, Prasun Kumar Gupta, Raian Vargas Maretto

entry.summary: Detects small dark fishing vessels that do not broadcast AIS using nighttime-light satellite imagery from SDGSAT-1 with a dual-branch YOLO11 model that fuses 10-meter panchromatic and 40-meter RGB bands. Applied to maritime monitoring along India's west coast.

entry.title: DUET: A Diversity-Quality Duet of Distillation Experts for Two-Step Video Generation

author.name: Zian Li, Litong Gong, Borui Liao, Pengfei Liu, Xinyu Wang, Xinyuan Wei, Yifan Gao, Tiezheng Ge, Muhan Zhang

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.09637v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Diffusion models have enabled high-quality video generation in recent years, but the high cost of iterative sampling hinders their practical deployme...

entry.title: Cultivar: A Contrastive and Locale-Oriented Translation Benchmark for Investigating Contamination and Localisation Robustness

author.name: Pinzhen Chen, Koel Dutta Chowdhury, Xiaoya Xu, David Tan, Doreen Osmelak, Ona de Gibert, Ariun-Erdene Tumurchuluun, Ashok Urlana, Fedor Sizov, Hale Sirin, Jesujoba Alabi, Karrar Talib Abed, Mateusz Klimaszewski, Nikolay Bogoychev, Niyati Bafna, Patricia Schmidtova, Preksha Manjunath Shanbhag, Sherrie Shen, Vilem Zouhar, Vivek Iyer, Yasser Hamidullah, Yusser Al Ghussin, Zheng Zhao

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.09766v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Multilingual translation benchmarks are typically sourced in English and translated into other languages, treating language pairs as the unit of eval...

entry.title: Unimodality-Promoting Regularized Learning for Ordinal Regression

author.name: Ryoya Yamasaki

entry.summary: Analyzes regularized learning that pushes predicted conditional class distributions toward unimodal shapes in ordinal regression, arguing this reduces prediction variance without much bias when the data really is close to unimodal. Provides a formal treatment of when the unimodality prior helps.

entry.title: MGMCL: Multi-Granularity Manifold Contrastive Learning With Neural ODEs for Cross-Subject EEG Emotion Recognition

author.name: Xiang Xie

entry.summary: MGMCL reformulates cross-subject EEG emotion recognition as continuous representation learning on symmetric positive definite Riemannian manifolds, adding contrastive objectives at instance, emotion and trajectory levels. Manifold neural ODEs model emotional dynamics as continuous trajectories rather than discrete labels.

entry.title: Federated Attention Autoencoders with a Stochastic Aggregation Scheme for Anomaly Detection

author.name: Mihailo Ili\'c, Milo\v{s} Savi\'c, Vladimir Kurbalija, Mirjana Ivanovi\'c, Giancarlo Fortino, Du\v{s}an Jakoveti\'c

entry.summary: Proposes two aggregation functions designed for attention-based autoencoders in federated anomaly detection, arguing that standard averaging destroys information stored in attention memory modules. Evaluates the resulting federated outlier detectors on decentralized data.

entry.title: Satellite Trajectory Optimization via Proximal Policy Optimization for Space Debris Avoidance

author.name: Logan Luna (Georgia Institute of Technology), Juan Ortiz Couder (Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University), Raul Alejandro Vargas-Acosta (Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University)

entry.summary: Trains a proximal policy optimization agent for autonomous satellite collision avoidance using an open-source high-fidelity astrodynamics simulator, motivated by rising conjunction alerts from megaconstellations. Positions learned policies as more scalable than current manual or rule-based practices.

entry.title: PET/CT Radiogenomic Mutation Prediction in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Using Multi-Label Learning

author.name: Mona Furukawa, Sai Hyne, Daniel R. McGowan, Bart{\l}omiej W. Papie\.z

entry.summary: Uses deep learning on PET/CT imaging to predict EGFR, TP53, and KRAS mutation status in non-small cell lung cancer, aiming to reduce reliance on invasive biopsy. It tests whether pairwise multi-label training beats single-gene classifiers.

entry.title: Crowd-Sourced Geographies of Income: Using Google Maps Points of Interest as High-Frequency Proxies for Sub-Municipal Income Estimation in Sao Paulo, Brazil

author.name: Adrienne C. Kinney, Anya Workman, Ademar Takeo Akabane, Jenna Barac, Paulo Fernando Braga Carvalho, Jeova Farias, Fernando Nascimento, Paulo Ricardo da Silva Oliveira

entry.summary: Tests whether the mix of crowd-sourced Google Maps points of interest can proxy household income across more than 26,000 census sectors in Sao Paulo, filling gaps between costly decennial censuses. Sparse POI count features are compressed with PCA and NMF and fed to a sweep of regression models.

entry.title: NeuroGuard: Neural Gradient Update Aware of Representation Damage

author.name: Taigo Sakai, Kazuhito Hotta

entry.summary: NeuroGuard controls how strongly the feature representation is updated at each task boundary in long-tailed class-incremental learning, rather than modifying replay, classifiers, or losses. Adaptive gradient scaling from teacher uncertainty and confidence-ranked distillation reweighting are added to an existing replay baseline without new parameters.

entry.title: Learning under Opponent Unawareness in Linear-Quadratic Stochastic Games

author.name: Dantong Chu, Xuefeng Gao, Yufei Zhang

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.08268v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As firms increasingly deploy machine learning for strategic decision-making, understanding algorithmic interactions has become central to operations ...

entry.title: Sparse Attention to Emotion: Efficient Facial Emotion Recognition via Token Reduction

author.name: Aya Manel Zitouni, Aicha Zenakhri, Karim Haroun, Larbi Boubchir

entry.summary: Argues that facial emotion recognition needs only discriminative regions such as eyes, mouth, and cheeks, and therefore discards uninformative image tokens to cut the quadratic cost of vision transformers. The goal is edge-deployable emotion recognition.

entry.title: RynnValue: Scaling Robotic Value Foundation Models with Temporal Distance

author.name: Dongchi Huang, Hongyin Zhang, Bohan Hou, Siteng Huang, Zhian Su, Hang Guo, Tong Lu, Zhaofeng Xu, Jiahao Tang, Jianfei Yang, Donglin Wang, Peixi Peng, Mingxiu Chen, Deli Zhao, Xin Li

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.09853v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: General-purpose reward models are increasingly the bottleneck for scaling robot learning, yet the recipe for learning value-related capabilities from...

entry.title: Evaluating Dedicated Monolingual and Joint Multilingual Causal Models for Dravidian Languages

author.name: Venkata Naga Sai Vishnu Rohit Pulipaka

entry.summary: Trains five small GPT-2 scale models from scratch to compare four dedicated monolingual Dravidian language models against one joint multilingual model with a shared larger vocabulary, evaluating perplexity, bits-per-byte, tokenizer efficiency, and fine-tuning transfer. Provides controlled evidence on the monolingual versus multilingual tradeoff for underrepresented languages.

entry.title: APEX-VW: A Document-Level English-Spanish Post-Editing Dataset in the Healthcare Domain

author.name: Marie Escribe, Tharindu Ranasinghe, Amal Haddad Haddad, Hansi Hettiarachchi, Damith Premasiri

entry.summary: Releases a document-level English-Spanish automatic post-editing corpus built from recent healthcare virtual-ward documents with professional post-editing in a real translation tool and controlled machine translation and terminology settings. Designed to study how corrections propagate across segments, which sentence-level corpora cannot capture.

entry.title: Wisdom in Unity: The Role of Multilingual Training in Figurative Language Identification in Proverbs

author.name: Rama Alomair, Remas Alsubaie, Walaa Saifalislam, Rima Alsonbul, Mona Alnajjar, Razan Aldossari, Haya Alibrahim, Abeer Aldayel

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.08090v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Although multilingual approaches to figurative language identification are not new, the shift beyond language homogeneous training data requires a clea...

entry.title: Tree-of-Experience: Hierarchical Experience Management for Self-Evolving Agents

author.name: Zihao Deng, Yining Zhu, Leiming Wang, Jingfei Lu, Junbo Wang, Chuncheng Ran, Yu Yang, Dixuan Yang, Jikun Shen

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.09044v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Continual self-evolution requires LLM agents to transform environmental interactions into reliable and reusable experience. Existing methods typically ...

entry.title: Measuring the Tokenization Premium: A Cost Audit for Underserved Language Communities

author.name: Avijit Roy, Proma Roy, Hrishitva Patel

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.09046v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as general-purpose educational and technical assistance systems, but their underlying infrastructure do...

entry.title: Structured Phonological Representations for Audio-Articulatory rtMRI Speech Classification

author.name: Abner Hernandez, Tom\'as Arias Vergara, Daiqi Liu, Andreas Maier, Paula Andrea P\'erez-Toro

entry.summary: This study tests whether representations from a phonological-feature model help classify articulatory patterns captured by real-time vocal-tract MRI paired with audio. It compares self-supervised speech baselines against models augmented with structured phonological features under unseen-speech and unseen-speaker conditions.

entry.title: Anatomically Consistent Cross-Contrast Super-Resolution of Anisotropic Brain T2w MRI

author.name: Mengqi Shen, Haicheng Wang, Meghna Trivedi, Tony J. Wang, Yuanguang Xu, Yingyan Zeng, Yading Yuan

entry.summary: Presents a cross-contrast super-resolution pipeline that uses high-resolution T1-contrast MRI to restore through-plane resolution of anisotropic T2-weighted brain scans without needing isotropic ground truth. A view-independent patch generator learns local anatomical correspondence and is then applied across orthogonal views.

entry.title: EvTrajGS: Accurate and Efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting from Unposed Event Streams

author.name: Zixuan Chen, Jiakai Zhang, Junhao Dong, Guangcong Wang, Jianhuang Lai, Yew-Soon Ong, Xiaohua Xie

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.08585v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Event cameras, with high temporal resolution, high dynamic range, and asynchronous sensing characteristics, have shown great potential for dense 3D rec...

entry.title: Visual Token Codec: Unleashing Spatial Redundancy for ViT Feature Coding

author.name: Donghui Feng, Fengxi Zhang, Changsheng Gao, Wenhan Yang, Qi Wang, Qunshan Gu, Hongwei Hu, Zhengxue Cheng, Li Song

entry.summary: Handles 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstruction when input photos have heterogeneous JPEG compression quality, using each file's stored quantization tables to build a view-specific compression operator so rendered views are compared in a matched domain. This prevents blocking and ringing artifacts from corrupting shared Gaussians.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Traffic Accident Detection via a Coarse-to-Fine VLM-Tracking Pipeline

author.name: Dipit Saha, Shah Mohammad Abdul Mannan, Mohammad Raihan Rashid, Ruwad Naswan, Ahnaf Tahmid

entry.summary: A completely training-free pipeline for detecting and characterizing traffic accidents in CCTV video, combining a frozen open-weight vision-language model with an object detector and tracker in a coarse-then-fine two-pass temporal localization strategy. It targets a benchmark that forbids labeled real-world training data.

entry.title: AeroReformer2: Spoken-Query Referring Segmentation for Aerial Images

author.name: Rui Li, Chenxi Duan, Haoyang Yang

entry.summary: Introduces a spoken-query benchmark for referring segmentation in aerial and remote-sensing imagery, adding accent- and voice-diverse speech plus rotor, wind, and mixed noise at several signal-to-noise levels, together with an efficient bilateral audio-visual segmentation network. The motivation is hands-free target specification for drone operators.

entry.title: Bootstrapping Vision-Language Model for Hysteroscopic Surgical Scene Segmentation

author.name: Jun Huang, Meiyi Chen, Zijie Yue, Yuhang Xiao, Fang Li, Hanli Wang, Xiaowen Tong, Yi Guo, Miaojing Shi

entry.summary: Presents what the authors describe as the first vision-language-model-based segmentation method for hysteroscopic surgical scenes, covering fifteen categories despite high morphological similarity among lesions and artifacts such as specular reflection, blur, and fluid occlusion. It pairs a pretrained image encoder with language-guided decoding.

entry.title: Degraded Infrared Small Object Detection via Degradation-Adapted Physics-Guided Restoration

author.name: Xinkai Lu, Wenjun Chen, Yi Li, Yi Chang, Luxin Yan

entry.summary: Builds an infrared small-object detector that first classifies degradation type and severity such as fog or sensor nonuniformity, routes to dedicated physics-guided restoration branches, and fuses the results before detection. It aims to generalize across degradation types rather than assuming one.

entry.title: Efficient Human-Contact Representation for Human-Scene Interaction

author.name: Nghia Vu, Tuong Do, Binh X. Nguyen, Erman Tjiputra, Anh Nguyen

entry.summary: The authors introduce sparse contact masks as a compact representation of where a human body touches its environment, then build spatial models on top for human-scene interaction tasks. The claim is large reductions in redundant high-dimensional contact input while keeping accuracy.

entry.title: CoInS-Net: A Continuous Position-Aware Network for Joint Medical Image Interpolation and Segmentation

author.name: Yujia Sun, Ningfeng Que, Peiting Shi, Rongrong Fu, Yingying Yang, Xinhang Li, Yin Dai

entry.summary: CoInS-Net jointly performs through-plane interpolation and lesion segmentation on anisotropic medical volumes using a continuous position-aware design, instead of running interpolation and segmentation as separate cascaded stages. The goal is to exploit complementary cross-slice structure and avoid redundant computation.

entry.title: DocPure: Prompt-Free Unified Document Restoration via Degradation-Aware Structure-Guided Wavelet Modulation

author.name: Lingming Su (College of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence, Wenzhou University, Wenzhou, China), Wanglong Lu (College of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence, Wenzhou University, Wenzhou, China, AI Analytics Team, Nasdaq, St. John's, Canada), Tao Wang (vivo Mobile Communication Co., Ltd, Shanghai, China), Kaihao Zhang (College of Engineering and Computer Science, The Australian National University, Canberra, Australia), Nan Zhang (College of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence, Wenzhou University, Wenzhou, China), Liyan An (College of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence, Wenzhou University, Wenzhou, China), Hanli Zhao (College of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence, Wenzhou University, Wenzhou, China)

entry.summary: DocPure is a prompt-free unified document restoration model that predicts clean structural priors with a degradation-aware autoencoder and uses wavelet-domain modulation to handle multiple degradation types in one network. It avoids per-degradation models, manual task prompts and paired cross-task data.

entry.title: Towards Collaborative Joint Perception and Prediction: Framework, Baseline Evaluation, and Deployment Perspectives

author.name: Lei Wan, Hannan Ejaz Keen, Alexey Vinel

entry.summary: This work outlines a conceptual framework and baseline evaluation for collaborative joint perception and prediction among connected vehicles, unifying V2X-shared perception with motion forecasting to reduce error accumulation and occlusion effects. It also discusses deployment considerations such as communication constraints.

entry.title: PressureMesh: 3D Human Mesh Estimation from Multi-Device Pressure Images

author.name: Changhai Ma, Ziyu Wu, Yunkang Zhang, Fangting Xie, Mengting Niu, Heyu Ding, Quan Wan, Jiayue Yuan, Boyan Liu, Yi Ke, Xiaohui Cai

entry.summary: PressureMesh (MDP-Net) reconstructs 3D human body meshes from temporal pressure-sensor images spanning multiple devices, using a mixture-of-experts style fusion to combine cross-device signals. It extends privacy-preserving pressure-based pose monitoring beyond single-mat coverage limits.

entry.title: VideoVIBE: A Video-Grounded Diagnostic Benchmark for One-Shot Interactive Website Generation

author.name: Jiajun Xu, Yanghao Zhou, Jingyun Liao, Yu Bai, Jinxing Zhou, Chengliang Liu, Changsen Yuan, Bo Wang, Qian Liu

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.09573v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Natural-language-driven "vibe coding" enables the one-shot generation of visually rich and interactive web applications, yet reliable assessment of the...

entry.title: TeaMatch: Teachable Cross-Modal Representation Learning for 2D-3D Matching

author.name: Chongjian Wang, Junjie Gao

entry.summary: TeaMatch introduces teachability, defined as how well a representation can be recovered by weak student learners under degraded inputs, as a training criterion for image-to-point-cloud matching. The claim is that representations that survive weak-learner recovery are structurally more robust to noise, low overlap and ambiguous geometry.

entry.title: EgoHieraLoc: A Cortically Inspired Hierarchical Segmentation-Guided Framework for Egocentric Visual Query Localization

author.name: Yifei Cao, Guolong Wang, Mingliang Hou, Xiya Bu, Daming Liu, Yu Liu

entry.summary: EgoHieraLoc localizes queried objects in egocentric video through a hierarchical, biologically motivated pipeline that screens foreground candidates, refines with global-local feedback and fuses evidence across viewpoints by credibility. It handles both 2D and 3D visual query localization in one framework.

entry.title: Diffuse the object, keep its label: curating detector training data from a few unlabeled photographs via VLM-built 3D vegetation scenes

author.name: Mario Malizia, Marnix Enting, Rob Haelterman, Ken Hasselmann

entry.summary: This work synthesizes labeled detector training data for small objects hidden in vegetation by having a vision-language model build a coarse 3D scene from a single site photo, placing 3D object meshes to obtain boxes, masks and occlusion for free, then re-texturing renders with a diffusion pass under a graded mask lock. It avoids manual annotation and cross-site label reuse.

entry.title: NTIRE 2026 Low-light Enhancement: Twilight Cowboy Challenge

author.name: Aleksei Khalin, Egor Ershov, Artyom Panshin, Sergey Korchagin, Georgiy Lobarev, Arseniy Terekhin, Sofiia Dorogova, Amir Shamsutdinov, Yasin Mamedov, Bakhtiyar Khalfin, Bogdan Sheludko, Emil Zilyaev, Nikola Bani\'c, Georgy Perevozchikov, Radu Timofte, Shuai Liu, Yuqian Zhang, Lize Zhang, Yibin Huang, Chaoyu Feng, Luyang Wang, Xiaotao Wang, Dongqing Zou, Lei Lei, Tianli Liu, Dejun Hao, Chunxia Lei, Furkan K{\i}nl{\i}, Andrei Mironov, Alexander Dikov, Aleksei Sadokhin, Vladimir Zvorygin, Constantine Habarlak, Shuwei Yue, Egor Mirantsov, Daniil Okunev, Dmitry Arkhipov, Aleksandr Yugay, Anas M. Ali, Bilel Benjdira, Wadii Boulila, Wei Zhou, Linfeng Li, Lingdong Kong, Jiachen Tu, Guoyi Xu, Yaoxin Jiang, Jiajia Liu, Yaokun Shi

entry.summary: This report reviews a low-light enhancement challenge in which participants had to merge misaligned raw smartphone burst frames captured at night into one clean image, coupling denoising and illuminant correction with geometric alignment. It includes a new 585-scene real-world dataset for training and benchmarking.

entry.title: World Simulator: Queer Erotica and the Absurdity of AI Video Models That Promise the World

author.name: Adam Cole, Mick Grierson

entry.summary: This artistic research piece feeds explicit gay erotica through a video-to-video pipeline to expose how models marketed as world simulators hallucinate absurd substitutes for content absent from their training data. It uses the resulting surreal outputs as a critique of universality claims in generative video.

entry.title: A Dynamic-Semantics Framework for Grounding Human Referring Expressions in Visual Perceptual Data

author.name: Joseph Bingham

entry.summary: This paper builds a dynamic-semantics framework for lexical entrainment, externalizing the evolving conventions between a human and a system into three explicit sets of referent-object bindings updated by a context-change rule over a lightweight visual grounding pipeline. It responds to evidence that current vision-language models fail to shorten, reuse or stabilize referring expressions across turns.

entry.title: AutoPSO: A Meta-Framework for Automated Particle Swarm Optimization

author.name: Xinmeng Yu, Jiaxin Gao, Jianguo Zhang, Dongmei Jiang, Ran Cheng

entry.summary: AutoPSO is a meta-framework that automates the design of particle swarm optimization variants by searching over a structured space of parameter schedules, topologies and update rules, with GPU-accelerated implementation to overcome CPU-bound scalability limits. It aims to replace hand-crafted, problem-specific variants with reusable automated configuration.

entry.title: A Reconfigurable Tracked Robot for Enhanced Obstacle Traversal Through Movable Articulation Point and Internal Mass Relocation

author.name: Yuki Uda, Yasutaka Nakashima, Motoji Yamamoto, Ayato Kanada

entry.summary: TRASER is a tracked robot that can relocate both its articulation point and internal mass using a tape-spring spine, trading off front-end reach against stability for better step and ditch traversal. Geometric and static models predict how articulation and center-of-mass position affect obstacle negotiation.

entry.title: Knowledge-Distilled End-to-End Reinforcement Learning for Smooth 6-DOF Thrust Control and Rapid Adaptation to Ocean Currents in Remotely Operated Vehicles

author.name: Tiankuang Wen, Huiping Li, Gang Liu, Yong Jiang

entry.summary: TSRCA-PPO uses two-stage knowledge distillation within end-to-end reinforcement learning to give remotely operated underwater vehicles smooth 6-DOF thrust control with fast adaptation to ocean currents. It targets a combination of low steady-state error, quick transients, energy efficiency, and smooth force output under disturbance.

entry.title: HarnessWAM: Bridging Prediction and Deliberation in World Action Models

author.name: Zhaopeng Gu, Bingke Zhu, Tianxi Lin, Guibo Zhu, Yingying Chen, Kai Wang, Tingyu Yuan, Chaoyang Zhao, Zhaowen Li, Peng Su, Jinqiao Wang

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.09516v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly learn environmental dynamics and robot actions, introducing priors over physical evolution into embodied control. Ho...

entry.title: Nonlinear Model Predictive Control of a Robotic Soft Esophagus

author.name: Dipankar Bhattacharya, Ryman Hashem, Leo K. Cheng, Weiliang Xu

entry.summary: Adds embedded time-of-flight and pressure sensing to a robotic soft esophagus so peristaltic waves and air-pressure profiles can be controlled in closed loop with nonlinear model predictive control, replacing the earlier open-loop operation. The device serves as an in vitro testbed for esophageal stents and food-viscosity studies.

entry.title: H2: A Dual Hybrid Semantic Data Lake Architecture for Medical Data Harmonization with Human-In-the-Loop verified, LLM Driven Metadata Annotation System

author.name: Ioannis N. Tzortzis, Georgia Kapetadimitri, Agapi Davradou, Nefeli Kousta, Nikolaos Bakalos, Ioannis Rallis, Dimitrios Kalogeras, Nikolaos Doulamis, Anastasios Doulamis

entry.summary: Describes a dual hybrid semantic data lake architecture for harmonizing heterogeneous medical data spanning images, text, time series, and inconsistent tabular schemas, using LLM-driven metadata annotation with human verification. The aim is to prevent flexible medical data lakes from degenerating into unusable data swamps.

entry.title: Agentic AI-driven Immersive Simulation: A Knowledge-Aware Virtual Training Platform forHigh Dose Rate (HDR) Brachytherapy

author.name: Ronghua Xu, Kepha Barasa, Manoj Kumal, Xinyun Liu, Weihua Zhou, Xin Qian

entry.summary: Combines virtual reality simulation with a retrieval-augmented LLM assistant to create an immersive, risk-free training environment for high dose rate brachytherapy procedures. The knowledge-aware agent supports personalized guidance without requiring physical anatomy or live radioactive sources.

entry.title: Coordinate-Residual Physics-Driven Neural Network for Electromagnetic Inverse Scattering

author.name: Yutong Du, Zicheng Liu, Bo Qi, Yali Zong, Peixian Han

entry.summary: Proposes a physics-driven neural network for three-dimensional electromagnetic inverse scattering that reconstructs contrast distributions directly from normalized spatial coordinates with a residual convolutional design, avoiding the unstable region-selection step used by prior accelerated solvers. Reduces reliance on labeled training data for an ill-posed imaging problem.

entry.title: Focus particles and scalar inferences across humans and language models

author.name: Catherine M. Brousse, Nelu D. Radpour

entry.summary: Studies how much translated multilingual supervision contributes to figurative language identification using 742 proverb concepts across nearly 6,800 translated instances in seven languages, with progressively increased multilingual training. Also introduces a multidimensional proverb annotation scheme covering metaphorical, moral, cause-effect, and culture-specific forms.

entry.title: North Africa's Missing Framework: NLP-Driven Mental Healthcare in Algeria and Implications for Low-resource Settings

author.name: Meriem Laifa, Abdallah Bengueddoudj

entry.summary: Presents a conceptual framework for how NLP could support mental healthcare in Algeria, identifying structural barriers including a language-of-care gap, geographic access inequities, and stigma. Draws on global mental health NLP work, Algerian health system literature, and low-resource NLP methods to propose directions transferable to other underserved settings.

entry.title: Mawqif-v2: An Arabic Benchmark Dataset for Cross-Target Stance Detection

author.name: Rasha Albalawi, Nuha Albadi, Hamzah Luqman, Maram Kurdi, Saad Ezzini, Asma Yamani, Ahmed Ashraf

entry.summary: Releases 996 manually annotated Arabic tweets across three new targets with stance, sentiment, and sarcasm labels, intended as a held-out evaluation set for cross-target stance generalization when training on the original dataset. Establishes baselines with Arabic and multilingual models.

entry.title: Impact of Dataset Composition on Embedded Real-Time UAV Wildfire Detection Using Compact YOLO Models

author.name: Eduardo de los Santos, Andre S. Kelbouscas, Ricardo B. Grando, Bruna V. Guterres

entry.summary: The study measures how mixing AI-generated wildfire images and standard augmentation into training sets affects compact YOLO detectors deployed on UAV hardware. Four dataset configurations are compared to see whether synthetic data helps real-time embedded detection.

entry.title: SRE-FER: Regional residual evidence learning for mitigating local evidence dilution in fine-grained facial expression recognition

author.name: Jiaye Song, Ruochen Zhang, Yuliang Wang, Jiaqi Wu

entry.summary: Shows that naively reading out global features from a self-supervised vision foundation model dilutes sparse, localized muscular cues needed for fine-grained facial expression recognition. The proposed readout adds zero-initialized regional residual logits that refine class boundaries without disturbing the backbone.

entry.title: Task-Adaptive 3D Cross-Field MRI Translation via Field-Conditioned Content-Style Pretraining

author.name: Haowen Pang, Yingqi Hao, Pengli Zhu

entry.summary: A challenge submission for translating MRI across field strengths from very low to ultra-high field, using field-conditioned content-style pretraining for unpaired 3D translation because multi-field scans of the same subject are rarely available. It handles several task variants including any-to-any synthesis.

entry.title: Adaptive Two-Level Allocation of a Conserved Capacity Budget Across Locations and Service Classes

author.name: Simone Mainardi, Kaushal Bansal, Prabhat Singh

entry.summary: Proposes a two-level algorithm for splitting a fixed capacity budget across locations and across two service classes, redistributing within a class by proportional deficit and excess and then lending between classes. The authors prove exact budget conservation, non-negativity, and single-iteration convergence under stated conditions.

entry.title: Generative Models: Principles, Architectures, and Applications

author.name: Jun Lu

entry.summary: A book-length treatment of generative modeling covering foundational principles, mathematical underpinnings, and practical architectures across images, text, video, and molecular design. It is educational material rather than new research.

entry.title: A Minimal $\kappa$--$\tau$ Logic for Risk-Sensitive Abduction

author.name: Remo Pareschi

entry.summary: A formal logic proposal for abductive reasoning that adds two primitives: interaction among competing hypotheses and an explicit threshold governing when to commit to an explanation. The aim is to treat the timing of commitment as a first-class, risk-sensitive decision in high-stakes diagnosis. It is a theoretical contribution with no empirical validation on modern systems.

entry.title: AquiLLM: An Architecture for Supporting Tacit Knowledge Capture in Research Groups

author.name: Jack Stark, Srinath Saikrishnan, Vikram Seenivasan, Bernie Boscoe, Andrew Lizarraga, Tuan Do

entry.summary: An update to an open-source retrieval-augmented system built for research groups to capture tacit knowledge, adding local embedding and reranking, multimodal ingestion, OpenAI-compatible interfaces, and semantic plus episodic memory. The motivation is avoiding transparency, reproducibility and privacy problems of proprietary assistants in scientific workflows. Primarily a tooling and engineering report.

entry.title: CoRe-UIE: Rethinking Coexisting and Region-wise Degradation for Underwater Image Enhancement

author.name: Weifeng Kong, Chenghao Xu, Lin Chen, Ziheng Cao, Guanying Huo

entry.summary: Proposes a mixture-of-experts style restoration network for underwater images, with a shared content-preserving expert plus routed experts specialized for color, haze, texture, and illumination degradations that coexist in different image regions. Aims to replace uniform restoration with region-adaptive expert collaboration.

entry.title: Does a Toehold Make a Bidder Bolder? Preemption and Multiplicity in Multi-Round Takeover Auctions

author.name: Zain Naboulsi

entry.summary: Models takeover contests as multi-round escalating auctions and computationally solves for equilibria to test whether holding a pre-bid stake actually deters rival bidders, finding the deterrence channel does not survive the richer game. Uses certified numerical solutions to support the claims.

entry.title: FedTVD: Balancing Data Quality and Quantity for Robust Federated Learning

author.name: Radwan Selo, Majid Kundroo, Taehong Kim

entry.summary: FedTVD weights client contributions during federated aggregation using both dataset size and total variation distance between local label distribution and a uniform global reference. It aims to reduce bias from label-skewed clients relative to FedAvg.

entry.title: When Can Fraud Operations Authorize Automation? A Decision-Support Framework for Fresh Audit Evidence and Review Workload

author.name: Jie Deng (Tongji University, Shanghai, China)

entry.summary: Proposes freshness-constrained audit capacity, a decision framework that treats automating fraud decisions as an authorization question governed by action risk, evidence recency and available analyst review capacity. Regions supported by mature randomized audits within a temporal allowance get automated; the rest stay under human review.

entry.title: Multi-Relational Knowledge Graph Enhanced Embedding for Trajectory-User Linking

author.name: Zhifeng Chu, Bin Wang

entry.summary: MakeTUL applies knowledge graph representation learning to trajectory-user linking by organizing visit-time, point-of-interest category and transfer relations into a multi-relational graph shared across trajectories. The goal is to avoid learning spatial, temporal and semantic features in isolation.

entry.title: A Domain-Structured Ensemble Framework for Perioperative Outcome Prediction Using Electronic Health Record Data

author.name: Shikhar Shukla, Cristina Barboi

entry.summary: Builds a perioperative risk model that organizes electronic health record predictors into patient, surgery and anesthesia domains, fits gradient boosting per domain, and combines them with a logistic meta-learner. Demonstrated on postoperative delirium prediction in a matched case-control sample of about 5,400 encounters.

entry.title: Deep Learning Imputation of Missing Radius of Maximum Winds (Rmax) Values in Tropical Cyclone Best-Track Data

author.name: Swastik Agrawal, Nishkal Hundia, Ziyue Liu, Michelle Bensi

entry.summary: Compares 1D convolutional networks, LSTMs and classical models for imputing the missing radius-of-maximum-winds variable in tropical cyclone best-track records, with physics-informed input augmentation and transfer learning from synthetic storm datasets to observational data. Including the radius of 34-knot winds substantially improves all models.

entry.title: Deep Multimodal Wearable Sensor Fusion for Detection of Body-Focused Repetitive Behaviors

author.name: Samaneh Rezaeimanesh, Mohsen Behradfar, Mohammad Fili, Guiping Hu

entry.summary: A multimodal deep learning pipeline detects body-focused repetitive behaviors such as hair pulling from wrist-worn inertial, thermal, and proximity sensors. A CNN plus gated recurrent unit backbone is used to separate compulsive gestures from similar everyday movements.

entry.title: Explainable Machine Learning in Healthcare: Methods, Interpretation, and Applications for Clinical Research

author.name: Krishna Padmanabhan, Minxin Lu, Dai Feng, Natalia KanDobrosky, Sai Konduri, Heather J. Litman, Achilleas Livieratos

entry.summary: A structured tutorial review of explainable ML tools including SHAP, LIME, partial dependence, and individual conditional expectation plots, illustrated on a public heart disease dataset. It offers guidance on interpretation, appropriate use, and pitfalls for clinical researchers.

entry.title: Eikonal Regularisation in Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Three-Dimensional Level-Set Advection: Transferability of Two-Dimensional Design Principles

author.name: Muhammad Akbar Khan

entry.summary: Tests whether hyperparameter design principles for eikonal regularization in level-set physics-informed networks transfer from two to three dimensions, sweeping six weights with three seeds across four 3D benchmarks. It checks both dimensional transfer and whether earlier single-seed conclusions survive run-to-run variance.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Condition Monitoring of SiC Power Modules

author.name: Mattia Scarpa, Evgeny Kusmenko, Francesco Toso, Mattia Bruschetta, Ruggero Carli, Simon Achatz

entry.summary: Proposes an embedded-friendly physics-informed condition monitoring approach for silicon carbide power modules with sintered packaging, whose aging behavior differs from solder-based devices. It targets in-field health state estimation where lifetime models are too slow and purely data-driven models generalize poorly.

entry.title: Failure-Mechanism Transferability of Cumulative-Damage Features for Health State Estimation of SiC Power Modules

author.name: Mattia Scarpa, Evgeny Kusmenko, Francesco Toso, Mattia Bruschetta, Ruggero Carli, Simon Achatz

entry.summary: Benchmarks five prognostics baselines against a physics-informed neural ODE for silicon carbide power module health estimation across two aging campaigns driven by structurally different failure mechanisms. The focus is whether performance transfers between solder fatigue and wire-bond lift-off, using cumulative thermoelectric features versus electrical precursors.

entry.title: Curriculum Generation under Structured Parametric Environments for Robust Navigation Policies

author.name: Prishita Ray

entry.summary: Proposes a reparameterized, gradient-based curriculum generation method over continuous environment parameters such as friction, slopes, and turn rates for training robust navigation policies. A distribution-shift regularizer is added to handle mixed image and scalar observation spaces.

entry.title: A Machine Learning Based Search for Lunar Anomalies

author.name: Cameron Kelahan, Daniel Angerhausen, Adam Lesnikowski, Valentin T. Bickel

entry.summary: Applies an existing beta-variational autoencoder anomaly detector to high-resolution Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter imagery to surface unusual surface features, including geologic formations and human-made objects such as landed spacecraft. Serves mainly as a scaled application and validation of prior unsupervised anomaly detection work.

entry.title: Degradation-Guided Underwater Image Restoration with Task-Oriented Latent Control

author.name: Xu Zhang, Xuhui Cao, Kangzhe Yuan, Laibin Chang, Yichu Xu, Shi Chen, Huan Zhang, Yong Chen

entry.summary: An underwater image restoration network that treats degradation cues as both a guide for spatially varying feature modulation and a signal to be suppressed in the latent representation before decoding. It addresses the tendency of skip connections to leak degradation-entangled features into outputs.

entry.title: High-Quality Exposure Correction with Diffusion-Based Image Generation Priors

author.name: Ziwen Li, Meng Cao, Jinpu Zhang, Chunyang Li, Long Bao, Heng Sun, Yuehuan Wang

entry.summary: Uses pretrained diffusion generative priors for photographic exposure correction, aiming to fix severely over- and under-exposed regions with better perceptual quality while retaining structural accuracy despite the stochastic sampling process. It targets the fidelity-versus-perceptual-quality trade-off in existing regression-based methods.

entry.title: SLAP: Selective Local Vision-Language Alignment for Fish Re-Identification via Partial Optimal Transport

author.name: Cigdem Beyan, Tonje Knutsen Sordalen, Kim Tallaksen Halvorsen

entry.summary: Fish individual re-identification is tackled with selective local alignment between image patch embeddings and multiple identity-aware text prompts using partial optimal transport, so background and non-discriminative regions are not forced into cross-modal correspondence. This adapts CLIP-style ReID to fine-grained animal marks.

entry.title: LightAIR: Lightweight Action Inversion and Riemannian Rectification for Text-based Person Anomaly Search

author.name: Yulun Zhang, Zixu Li, Zhiwei Chen, Zhiheng Fu, Wenbo Wang, Zihang Qiu, Zhilin Wang, Ruxin Wang, Yupeng Hu

entry.summary: Targets text-based person anomaly search, which requires matching both coarse appearance and micro-level abnormal actions, arguing that external pose estimators are fragile and implicit learning lets appearance features swallow subtle action cues. The method inverts action information lightweightly and applies a Riemannian rectification to contrastive optimization on hard negatives.

entry.title: GeoRoute: Geometry-Aware Hybrid Inference for Traffic Future-Frame Prediction

author.name: Khang Minh Le, Hieu Dinh Trung Pham, Luu Thanh Danh, Nam-Tien Le, Hieu Anh Ngo, Phuong Huu Vu Tran, Son Nguyen Minh Le, Nguyen Trong Nghia, Tu Tran Thi Cam, Huy Minh Nhat Nguyen, Cuong Tuan Nguyen

entry.summary: GeoRoute is a training-free inference framework that stabilizes long-horizon future-frame prediction in traffic scenes by injecting multi-frame temporal context and view-conditioned routing, with a depth-layered renderer refining front-camera predictions. It targets ghosting and geometry drift that appear when latent video diffusion models are applied to structured driving scenes.

entry.title: MSP-Net: Manifold-Guided Spectral Prompt Network for Hyperspectral Object Tracking

author.name: Juliu Li, Hanlin Qin, Shuowen Yang, Jingjing Li, Yuedong Tan, Shuai Yuan, Huixin Zhou

entry.summary: MSP-Net treats hyperspectral bands as points on a manifold and uses spectral prompts to adapt fusion dynamically instead of stacking bands in a fixed order like RGB channels. The aim is tracking that generalizes across heterogeneous hyperspectral sensors and changing target or scene conditions.

entry.title: ResemBrick: Brick Reconstruction from Photographs with Perceptual Fidelity and Buildability

author.name: Xilun Chen, Hanwen Wan, Yusong Zhao, Zexin Lin, Ruixiang Liao, Xiaoqiang Ji

entry.summary: ResemBrick reconstructs buildable, colored brick models from a few casual photographs by treating voxelization itself as an optimization variable under a fixed brick budget, balancing visual resemblance against structural stability. A resolution-conditioned network allocates occupied voxels in one forward pass.

entry.title: Search over the Visual World: Persistent Visual Memory, Layered Indexes, and Source-Grounded Evidence

author.name: Sankalp Nagaonkar, Rohit Garg, Ankit Raj, Ashish Choithani, Ashutosh Trivedi

entry.summary: This position and systems paper argues that agent-facing search over continuous visual streams from cameras, screens and archives is an infrastructure problem rather than a ranking problem, and formalizes persistent visual memory, layered indexes and source-grounded evidence. It offers a conceptual model of scene spaces coexisting over shared source time.

entry.title: Overcoming Data Scarcity and Confidentiality in Hardware Assurance via Synthetic Generation

author.name: Gijung Lee, Ronald Wilson, Damon L. Woodard, Domenic Forte

entry.summary: The authors propose a two-stage synthetic data pipeline for hardware assurance in which a StyleGAN learns layout mask distributions and a conditional GAN translates masks into realistic scanning electron microscope images, so datasets can be shared without exposing proprietary designs. Functional design information is deliberately distorted while visual realism is preserved.

entry.title: TDMA Based Communications Control Co-Design for Cooperative Carrying: Delay Calibration and Sampling-Rate Optimization

author.name: Zahra Seifaei, Maximilian Luebke, Torsten Reissland, Danial Dehghani, Norman Franchi

entry.summary: Studies communication-control co-design for multi-robot cooperative carrying under realistic TDMA wireless modeling in MuJoCo, comparing fixed sampling with static leadership, dynamic sampling, and dynamic sampling with rotating leadership. It reports a tradeoff in which adaptive sampling reduces delay effects but shifts wireless load in ways leader rotation can help distribute.

entry.title: RoSE: A Robotic Soft Esophagus for Endoprosthetic Stent Testing

author.name: Dipankar Bhattacharya, Sherine Jesna V. A., Leo K. Cheng, Weiliang Xu

entry.summary: Develops a bio-mimicking robotic soft esophagus as an in vitro platform for testing endoprosthetic stents, focusing on measuring the radial force stents exert on the esophageal wall, a key factor in migration. It aims to fill an evidence gap left by the scarcity of randomized clinical trials on stent design.

entry.title: Book Review: The Infinity Machine

author.name: Mikewins

entry.summary: A brief linkpost to a book review essay framed around a reported leadership transition at Google DeepMind, reflecting on the benefits and hazards of leaders who can accurately foresee much of the technological future. The post itself contains almost no substantive content beyond the framing.

entry.title: How to be an AI safety research engineer

author.name: Ruben Castaing

entry.summary: Practical career advice for entering AI safety as a research engineer, covering how to pick problems you actually care about, the importance of networking over job boards, and realistic expectations for how long upskilling and job hunting take. It functions as field-building content rather than research.

entry.title: Distribution-Free Conformal Prediction for Steel Fatigue Strength: Marginal Validity Is Not Enough

author.name: Irene Boruah

entry.summary: Applies conformal prediction to steel fatigue strength prediction, comparing five interval construction methods over 50 data splits. The central point is that marginal coverage can hide poor conditional coverage in specific regions of the fatigue-strength range.

entry.title: AraSSM: A bidirectional state-space encoder for Arabic masked language modeling

author.name: Ahmed Amine Aliane, Hassina Aliane, Nasredine Semmar

entry.summary: Compares human and language model scalar judgments for sentences containing focus particles such as even and only, testing whether stable alternative-set representations underlie both. Preliminary results on roughly one hundred items suggest similar surface outputs may come from different underlying mechanisms.

entry.title: IDRAAK: From Multi-Agent NLP to Few-Shot Prompting for Semantic Drift Detection in Technical Requirements

author.name: Shiva Ahir

entry.summary: Compares six workflows for detecting semantic drift in translated technical requirements, ranging from deterministic representation comparison to multi-agent verification and few-shot prompting, built around a language-independent requirement representation. Finds a single few-shot LLM call outperforms the more elaborate structured and multi-stage pipelines on synthetic perturbations and cross-lingual inference sets.

entry.title: DS@GT ARC at Touch\'e: Large Language Models for Retrieval-Augmented Debate

author.name: Anthony Miyaguchi, Conor Johnston

entry.summary: An extension of a shared-task submission using six LLMs in a retrieval-augmented pipeline to generate debate utterances and to grade responses against Gricean maxims. The analysis finds strong within-family evaluator agreement that does not reliably predict official evaluation scores.

entry.title: UPolarSQ: Polar Representation Learning for Optic Disc and Peripapillary Atrophy Segmentation and Quantification in Fundus Photographs

author.name: Mengxian He, Yunyun sun, Ziyue Gao, Wengkei Lam, Shunyi Zhang, Wu Yuan

entry.summary: Reformulates optic disc and peripapillary atrophy segmentation in fundus photographs by mapping an optic-disc-centered region into polar coordinates, where boundaries become radial profiles that can be regressed directly and turned into clinical biomarkers. This avoids fragmented masks and post-processing-dependent quantification.

entry.title: A Mixed-Stiffness Anthropomimetic Fingertip Broadens the Operating Range for Coin Grasping

author.name: Kaigen Go, Yinlai Jiang, Hiroshi Yokoi, Shunta Togo

entry.summary: Tests anthropomimetic fingertips with a stiff-sided, soft-centered silicone pad against uniformly soft pads for picking up coins from hard surfaces, showing that material-created boundaries can widen the range of conditions in which a geometric constraint enables precision grasp. An automated rig quantifies performance across oblique approach conditions.

entry.title: Scalable High-Speed Lateral Control for Single-Body and Articulated Autonomous Vehicles

author.name: Aashish Shaju, Steve Southward, Mehdi Ahmadian

entry.summary: Extends a clothoid-based lateral controller to high-speed path tracking for both single-body and articulated vehicles, adding Frechet-distance-based lookahead optimization, trajectory segment classification, and a dual-adaptive lookahead responsive to cross-track error and upcoming geometry. Flexible tracking-point selection supports tractor-trailer configurations.

entry.title: From Single Chatbots to Governed Agent Ecosystems: An Agentic AI Pattern Catalogue and Orchestration Framework for Mission-Critical Hospital Information Management Systems

author.name: Manideep Dhar, Ritwik Singh, Sharat Chandra Kumar Manikonda

entry.summary: Proposes a compliance-first catalogue of agentic AI design patterns and an orchestration framework for hospital information systems covering triage, documentation, scheduling, and revenue cycle workflows. It argues most hospital AI pilots stall before production because of architectural and governance gaps.

entry.title: The Capability Ladder: A Curriculum-Modernization Framework for Workforce Readiness in the AI Era

author.name: Majid Memari, George Rudolph

entry.summary: Proposes a curriculum-modernization framework for computing education arguing that AI drives task reallocation rather than wholesale job replacement, raising the value of verification, systems thinking, security, and AI supervision skills. It combines a narrative literature review with an illustrative pilot course.

entry.title: Constraining ontology mappings using metaphysical choices

author.name: Giacomo De Colle, Helena Blackmore, Chris Partridge

entry.summary: Proposes validating semantic mappings between data sources built on different foundation ontologies by making the underlying metaphysical commitments explicit, illustrated with cardinality constraints between two named upper ontologies. The principles are operationalized as SPARQL validation queries over a mapping pipeline.

entry.title: Smart Compaction: Predicting Compaction Utility from Lakehouse Table Metadata

author.name: Jannic Cutura, Subash Prakash

entry.summary: This paper trains gradient-boosted trees on metadata features from simulated data lakehouse tables to predict how much compaction would reduce file counts, achieving near-perfect fit, but then finds the binary decision reduces to one partition-level threshold requiring no model at all. The honest negative conclusion is arguably the most useful part. Relevant to data infrastructure tuning rather than AI research.

entry.title: Three Generations of Healthcare IT: From the Digital Record to the Computable Care Process

author.name: Alexander Apartsin, Yehudit Aperstein

entry.summary: A conceptual framework reorganizing health information technology by the unit of information a system makes computable, positing a third generation beyond records and clinical state whose object is patient-specific clinical intent, formalized as an actionable clinical record. The authors argue existing standards can represent intent once structured but cannot recover it from natural communication. Positions language models as the missing extraction layer.

entry.title: Integrated Multimodal AI System for Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning, Object Sensing, and Damage Analysis

author.name: Kalelo Dukuray, Israel Pina, Evan Perez, Erika Ardiles-Cruz, Jie Wei

entry.summary: An integrated system for damage assessment combining retrieval-augmented generation over project documentation, thermal perception, vision foundation model pipelines and exploratory wireless sensing, with comparisons of vector retrieval against a knowledge-graph variant. Dynamic retrieval improved grounding over static few-shot prompting for classification criteria. The contribution is systems integration for a defense-adjacent application.

entry.title: Sign Language Recognition Using Original and Synthetic Depth Image Based Point Cloud Data Models

author.name: Rustem Ozakar, Eyup Gedikli

entry.summary: Generates synthetic depth maps from RGB sign language video using a monocular depth estimator and compares PointNet-family classifiers trained on synthetic versus real depth point clouds across three sign datasets. Quantifies how much accuracy is lost when real depth sensors are unavailable.

entry.title: Failure-Aware Long-Form Translation: Design and Implementation of a Recoverable LLM Translation System

author.name: Yanlin Yu

entry.summary: An engineering report on a recovery protocol for deployed long-form LLM translation, where a request can succeed at the API level yet return empty, truncated, filtered, or prompt-contaminated output. Describes delayed release behind a small output window, assembled-output validation, typed stream events to distinguish replacement from continuation, and provenance-marked fallbacks with a shared deadline.

entry.title: Accurate but Natural? Diagnosing Grammatical and Idiomatic Gaps in Japanese EFL Writing

author.name: Steve Woollaston, Brendan Flanagan, Hiroaki Ogata

entry.summary: Builds a layered LLM correction pipeline that separates literal grammatical error correction from idiomatic revision across 3,830 English writings by 120 Japanese junior high students, then quantifies accuracy gaps versus idiomaticity gaps using a grammar-profile extractor. Shows distinct patterns for items like articles and third-person singular marking.

entry.title: PragyaDoc: A Universal Document Intelligence Framework for Multilingual Medical Document Understanding in Low-Resource Settings

author.name: Jagpal Singh Jhala

entry.summary: PragyaDoc is a four-stage pipeline combining ensemble OCR, geometric-lexical fusion, deterministic structuring, and dual-LLM reasoning to translate and explain English medical documents for speakers of Indian languages. It targets accessibility for rural patients and community health workers.

entry.title: Towards an LLM-based method for quantifying the sexual content in song lyrics

author.name: Ignacio M. Sticco

entry.summary: The paper presents an LLM-based, reproducible method for scoring song lyrics along several thematic dimensions and applies it to 1,259 reggaeton songs spanning two decades. It compares the derived explicitness scores against platform explicit-content labels and tracks changes over time.

entry.title: Multimodal Skin Lesion Classification with Swin Transformer and Clinical Metadata Fusion

author.name: Nethmi Pathirana, Isuru Munasinghe, Dileeka Alwis

entry.summary: A skin lesion classifier fuses Swin Transformer image features with structured clinical metadata and applies temperature scaling for post-hoc calibration. It reports around 92 percent accuracy with improved minority-class performance on a public dermoscopy dataset.

entry.title: AdapterMoE: A Two-Stage Hard-Routing Mixture-of-Experts Architecture for Multi-Crop Disease Recognition with Calibrated Rejection and Incremental Learning

author.name: Pin-Hsun Huang, Shaou-Gang Miaou

entry.summary: A mixture-of-experts design for multi-crop plant disease recognition that replaces learned soft routing with deterministic hard routing by crop identity, plus energy and nearest-neighbor out-of-distribution gates for rejecting non-target inputs and incremental addition of new crops. The objective is explicitly deployment cost and rejection stability rather than peak accuracy.

entry.title: Topology-Aware Global-Local Mamba Networks for Palm Vein Biometrics

author.name: Zhengxi Wu, Felix Marattukalam, Waleed H. Abdulla

entry.summary: A palm-vein biometric backbone that fuses multi-scale local texture, an edge-prior-guided directional stream, and a four-direction state-space global scan to capture both vessel texture and overall vascular topology. It reports very low error rates with a compact parameter budget on two public datasets.

entry.title: View-Adaptive Renderer for View-Consistent 2D-to-3D Generation

author.name: U-Chae Jun, Jaeeun Ko, Jiwoo Kang

entry.summary: Proposes a viewpoint-adaptive neural renderer for single-image 3D generation that tolerates inconsistencies among synthesized novel views, aiming to avoid the artifacts that projective ambiguity introduces into radiance-field reconstruction. It positions itself as cheaper than existing consistency-enforcement solutions.

entry.title: GenTrack3: Hybrid Stochastic-Deterministic Online Multi-Object Tracking with Cluster-Aware Association

author.name: Toan Van Nguyen, Rasmus G. K. Christiansen, Dirk Kraft, Leon Bodenhagen

entry.summary: GenTrack3 blends deterministic tracking-by-detection association with stochastic particle-style uncertainty modeling and adds cluster-aware association for crowded scenes. The stated goal is robustness to noisy detections without the full cost of stochastic filtering.

entry.title: MPISuperRes-PnP: A Super-Resolution Zero-Shot Plug-and-Play Reconstruction Algorithm for Magnetic Particle Imaging

author.name: Vladyslav Gapyak, Thomas M\"arz, Andreas Weinmann

entry.summary: This paper develops a zero-shot plug-and-play super-resolution reconstruction algorithm for Magnetic Particle Imaging, based on energy minimization with a learned denoiser prior rather than system-matrix upscaling or naive interpolation. It targets the coarse spatial grids of current MPI reconstruction.

entry.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation-Based Color Restoration for Low-Light Image Enhancement

author.name: Li-Wei Lu, Shaou-Gang Miaou

entry.summary: This method separates color restoration from brightness enhancement in low-light image enhancement, implementing color correction as a retrieval-augmented post-processing module that fetches reference color statistics instead of relying only on learned parametric priors. It targets systematic color casts such as greenish skies and yellowish faces.

entry.title: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Multitask Image Analysis in Realistic Context with Extreme Label Shift; Application to the CTAO first Large Sized Telescope

author.name: Micha\"el Dell'aiera, Thomas Vuillaume, Alexandre Benoit

entry.summary: This work combines unsupervised domain adaptation with multitask loss balancing under extreme class imbalance, validated on gamma-ray image analysis for a Cherenkov Telescope Array Observatory telescope where simulation-to-real gaps and rare signals coincide. It provides a comparative study of adaptation and balancing strategies in that realistic setting.

entry.title: HPSO: Particle Swarm Optimization with Hypergraph-Based Topology

author.name: Wenbin Pei, Xi Luo, Bing Xue, Mengjie Zhang, Qiang Zhang

entry.summary: HPSO replaces pairwise graph topologies in particle swarm optimization with hypergraph structures so that groups of particles can share higher-order social information during search. The claim is better navigation of complex landscapes than Ring or Star topologies allow.

entry.title: Self Supervised Learning from Automatically Generated Demonstrations for Visual Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Andres Rivas, Anselmo R. Cukla, Rodrigo S. Guerra, Bruna V. Guterres, Ricardo B. Grando

entry.summary: This work has a robot automatically generate its own demonstrations by perturbing around a target pose and then learn relative pose corrections from wrist-camera images, removing the need for teleoperation, manual labels or explicit camera-robot extrinsic calibration. The pipeline is built with ROS 2 and Isaac Sim.

entry.title: Enhancing Autonomous Vehicle Navigation with a Clothoid-Based Lateral Controller

author.name: Aashish Shaju, Steve Southward, Mehdi Ahmadian

entry.summary: A lateral controller for autonomous vehicles that fits clothoid (Euler spiral) segments at each timestep with an adaptive lookahead distance tuned to vehicle dynamics and road geometry, plus a lead filter for lag compensation. It targets smoother curvature transitions, better path tracking, and reduced rollover risk.

entry.title: Intuitive Hand Positional Guidance Using McKibben-Based Surface Tactile Sensations to Shoulder and Elbow

author.name: Kenta Yokoe, Yuki Funabora, Tadayoshi Aoyama

entry.summary: Builds a wearable fabric actuator using McKibben artificial muscles to deliver surface tactile sensations to the shoulder and elbow for guiding hand position, aiming for intuitive perception that does not require prior instruction or training. It contrasts with conventional tactile guidance schemes whose sensation-to-target mappings must be learned.

entry.title: Q: Is dual-use alignment-complete problem?

author.name: kapedalex

entry.summary: A short question post asking whether it is even possible to quantify how much a given research contribution advances alignment versus general capabilities, and whether that measurement problem is itself as hard as alignment. The author argues that grantmakers and researchers already make such judgments implicitly, so partial heuristics should be achievable.

entry.title: SuperLocalMemory 4.0: The Governed Memory Operating System for AI Agents

author.name: Varun Pratap Bhardwaj, Garima Singh, Arun Pratap Bhardwaj

entry.summary: A system paper describing a local-first governed memory layer for AI agents that fuses dense, lexical, temporal, associative and spreading-activation retrieval, plus access control, bi-temporal recall, audit trails and regulatory checklists. Version four adds reliability mechanisms for its write path such as fenced admission and a policy registry. The contribution is engineering integration rather than new research insight.

entry.title: Walking through Discussions: A Mobile Visual Analytics System for In-Situ Group Discussion Analysis

author.name: Yiping Sun, Ziyao Kang, Wei Zeng, Minli Wu, Jiazhi Xia
